name: oasislms-nexus
description: Ask questions about your OasisLMS learners, courses, exams, credits, and purchases in plain language.

interface.longDescription:
Nexus connects ChatGPT to your organization's OasisLMS learning management system, so you can explore and analyze LMS data by asking questions in plain language instead of writing database queries or switching between reports.

After you sign in with your OasisLMS account, Nexus gives read-only access to your own organization's data, including:

• Users and learners, including registrations and last logins
• Login and traffic activity by period, browser, and platform
• Course enrollments, progress, completion rates, and scores
• Content engagement with courses and course assets
• Exams, exam questions, item banks, and learner attempts
• Continuing education credit claims
• Course purchases, revenue, refunds, and coupon usage
• Catalog searches, evaluation responses, and mobile app usage

For example, you can ask which learners have been inactive recently, how logins changed over the last six months, which courses have the highest completion rates, how learners performed on an exam, or what purchasing trends look like this year.

Each organization connects only to its own OasisLMS environment through authenticated, permission-controlled access. Nexus never creates, changes, or deletes LMS data.
defaultPrompt: Summarize learner activity in our LMS over the last 90 days
Which courses had the highest completion rate this year?
Show course purchase revenue by month for this year

positive.prompt: How many users logged in to our LMS last month, and which platforms did they use?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns total logins, unique users, and a platform breakdown for the previous calendar month.

positive.prompt: Which courses had the highest completion rate this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns completion analytics for the current year and lists the courses with the highest completion rates.

positive.prompt: What was our total course purchase revenue by month this year?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns gross and net revenue for the current year grouped by month.
Returns a list of matching courses with their key details and the total match count.

positive.prompt: What membership levels exist in our LMS, and how many users are in each?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the membership-level values with record counts and percentages.

negative.description: Delete request: Nexus is read-only and cannot delete users
negative.prompt: Delete all users who have not logged in this year.

negative.description: Unrelated request: not about LMS data
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Chicago today?

negative.description: Enrollment change: Nexus cannot modify enrollments
negative.prompt: Enroll Jane Smith in the Safety Fundamentals course.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with read-only access to OasisLMS users, logins, courses, progress, exams, credits, and purchases, plus a getting-started skill.
